title: Volvo FM FH SERIES 4 High tensile Aluminium FUPS Compliant Radar Compatible Bullbar #50
description: Volvo Series 4, FM, FH. FUPS compliant hi-tensile powder coated aluminium Bullbar. A wide colour range to choose from. This style is only 138KG with Hi-tensile aluminium backing plate. Radar compatible. Dual tow pins and "Roo" cutters for maximum protection for the headlights. Combination Indicator repeater, daylight running lights in the outer uprights. Driving light mounts to customer requirements.
